scientific_integrity: Closed-form proof and exhaustive four-type row classification for all integer N>=2; finite checker is corroborative rather than a proof for infinite N. Full original source inspection performed for relevant comparisons; broader historical subset-selection priority remains uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic, two-column SPD Krylov basis, exactly two unweighted rows; scale-invariant whitening-condition distortion only. The distortion-optimal pair has small row magnitudes and may be unsuitable under additive noise or floating-point cancellation. No claim of solver-runtime, residual, or accuracy improvement.
title: Unbounded distortion gap for minimum-singular-value row selection on well-conditioned Krylov spaces
